from Xtracover ₹6,229.00
  • Peace of mind : Protect Your device today against any manufacturing defects, which could cost you 50-60% of the product price to repair. Also get convenience of doorstep pickup and repairs service.
  • The plan will start after the Brand warranty ends & will be active for next 1 Year. Only valid if purchased for a new device with a valid Brand / Manufacturing warranty. Not valid for renewed / refurbished products.
  • Service contract is email delivered and auto-activated if purchased for branded devices in Amazon. After ordering, for plan-related details, check 'Buyer/Seller messages' under Message Center at "amazon.in/msg" or check your Amazon regd email ID.
  • What’s included and What’s excluded: All labor, spare parts, & transportation charges for repairing the mechanical defects & electric malfunctions of the device will be covered as per the extended warranty. The plan does not cover Accidental or Liquid damages, Damage caused by unauthorized repairs, Accessories, Consumables, or parts that are not covered under the standard Brand warranty.
  • To claim call 8860396039 or write to contactus@xtracover.com or go to Amazon app >> Your Orders Section >> Find your Product order >> Click on “Get Product Support” > Schedule a service.

        Top-tier specs, excellent cameras, and future-proof performance.
        Reviewed in India on 29 April 2025
        Colour: Titanium BlackSize: 12GB + 256GBStyle Name: With exchange bonus or No cost EMI
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        The Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra continues the Ultra legacy with a device that’s powerful, polished, and packed with cutting-edge features. It’s clear Samsung aimed to solidify its position at the top of the premium smartphone market—and it mostly succeeds.

        Design and Display

        The S25 Ultra features a 6.9-inch Dynamic AMOLED 2X display with a 120Hz adaptive refresh rate, offering vibrant colors, deep blacks, and smooth scrolling.

        The display has a resolution of 3120 x 1440 pixels.

        It is protected by Corning Gorilla Glass Armor 2, which provides enhanced durability.

        The phone has a titanium frame and an IP68 rating for dust and water resistance.

        It also includes an embedded S Pen stylus.

        Software & Features

        Running One UI 7.1 based on Android 15, the user experience is smooth and customizable. Samsung’s commitment to 7 years of software updates gives it an edge over most Android competitors. The integration of Galaxy AI, such as real-time translation, generative photo editing, and productivity enhancements in Samsung Notes, brings genuinely useful features to the everyday experience.

        Camera

        The S25 Ultra has a quad-camera setup:

        200MP wide-angle primary camera

        50MP ultra-wide-angle camera

        10MP telephoto camera (3x optical zoom)

        50MP periscope telephoto camera (5x optical zoom)

        The front-facing camera is 12MP.

        The camera system supports 8K video recording, HDR, and various professional features.

        Performance and Hardware

        The S25 Ultra is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite processor.

        It comes with 12GB or 16GB of RAM.

        Storage options include 256GB, 512GB, and 1TB.

        The phone runs on Android 15 with Samsung's One UI 7.

        Battery

        The S25 Ultra has a 5000mAh battery.

        It supports 45W wired fast charging and 15W wireless charging.

        Other Features

        The phone supports 5G connectivity.

        It has an ultrasonic in-display fingerprint sensor.

        It includes Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 5.3, NFC, and USB Type-C.

        Summary

        The Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra is a premium smartphone with a top-of-the-line display, powerful performance, a versatile camera system, and a long-lasting battery. It also has an S Pen, which is useful for productivity and creativity.

        The Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra is easily one of the best flagship phones of the year. It feels premium the moment you pick it up — solid build, sharp design, and a gorgeous display that’s bright, vibrant, and incredibly smooth. The performance is top-tier; apps open instantly, multitasking is effortless, and the phone handles gaming or heavy tasks without any lag.

        The camera system is a major highlight. The photos are crisp, the night mode is excellent, and zoom shots come out surprisingly clean and detailed. It’s a phone that consistently delivers great results whether you’re shooting landscapes, portraits, or low-light scenes.

        Battery life is another strong point. It lasts comfortably through a full day even with heavy usage, and fast charging gets it back up quickly. Samsung’s software feels more refined than ever — clean, fluid, and loaded with genuinely useful features.

        Overall, the S25 Ultra is a powerhouse: premium design, stunning display, reliable battery, and one of the best camera setups on any smartphone. If you're looking for a no-compromise flagship, this is the one to get.

        I’ve been using the Galaxy S25 Ultra for a few weeks now, and I can confidently say this is one of the best devices Samsung has ever made. Everything from the display to the performance screams premium.

        > Display: Absolutely stunning. Bright, smooth, and vibrant — it's a joy to watch videos or play games.

        > Camera: The camera system is simply next level. Day or night, the photos are crisp and detailed.

        > Performance: Ultra-fast and super responsive. No lags, even with heavy multitasking and gaming.

        > Battery Life: Easily lasts me a full day. I charge it only up to 95%, and even then I get 7 hours 30 minutes+ screen-on time, with 15–20% battery still left at the end of the day.

        > Fingerprint Sensor: Fast and very accurate — never misses.

        > Build & Design: Premium feel in hand, and looks absolutely stunning.

        * Only con: The Bluetooth feature has been removed from the S Pen, which I found a bit disappointing considering how useful it was in previous models.

        Overall, I’m very, very happy with this device. Highly recommended for anyone looking for top-tier performance, best-in-class cameras, and long-lasting battery life in a premium phone.
